name: stat

provenance.source: Exact redmi-watch-6-3.100.043 IDB vela_ap.bin.i64 review (EVID-PLATFORM-HW-P65-001): ABI differs from the Supervisor's 104-byte layout: the exact stat entry is 0x1c1595a4 (vfs/fs_stat.c, inode_stat resolve=1, errno on failure; 0x1c15967c is lstat, 0x1c1594f8 nx_stat), but inode_stat 0x1c159300 clears a 96-byte struct stat with st_mode at +8, st_size (int64) at +24, and file_fchstat 0x1c1572b4 (the ported address) places st_atim/st_mtim/st_ctim as 16-byte timespecs at +32/+48/+64 (st_mtim.tv_sec int64 at +48). Not promoted; the Supervisor stat hook reads size at +32 and mtime at +72.
